name: USW-Pro-Max-16
title: Switch Pro Max 16
summary: 16-port L3 Etherlighting switch (12x 1G + 4x 2.5G, 2x 10G SFP+), USB-C powered, desk/wall/rack.

requires: UniFi OS console / gateway running UniFi Network (8.1.127+)

extra.rack_mount: 1U rack requires add-on Rack Mount accessory

gotchas: No PoE at all despite the 'Pro Max' name — for APs/cameras buy the USW-Pro-Max-16-PoE.
Only 4 of 16 ports are 2.5GbE; the other 12 are 1GbE.
Powered by an external 25W USB-C brick — no internal PSU or RPS backup.
Rack ears are a separate accessory.
best_for: desk/media-cabinet switch with a 10G uplink and a few multi-gig clients
